reply_text:
The ticket is #8841. I've replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

Where it comes from: Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.

One thing isn't confirmed: Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two because of the Central handoff note from January. It says Marrow Fieldworks, then Pree's dealer account, changed hands on 5 Jan 2026, and Tobias now has a dealer account. So in the reply I suggested Pree get a quick yes from Tobias before the call. I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older ticket for a different customer (Tansleigh Packaging, Door 6).

I only used things Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and the public files. A ticket number counts as an operational detail, not a finance figure, so posting it in the channel was fine.
